title: mygo-pocket card
description: pocket.json: one card on mygo-pocket's games screen. The directory holding it is the card; its name is the card's id.

kind.description: nx2linux: a Switch port (nx2a-data.json beside, launch.sh at the root runs it; the default when nx2a-data.json is there). mygo: a MyGo app in the directory. native: any other program in the directory. command: a program on PATH. retroarch: one ROM run by a libretro core.

title.description: The card's name. Required except for nx2linux, which defaults to nx2a-data.json's name.

subtitle.description: A second line under the title, e.g. the original name.

tag.description: The pill beside the title. Defaults by kind.

color.description: The card's light on the wallpaper. Defaults to a colour picked from the id.

cover.description: A 2:3 poster in the directory. Defaults to cover.jpg or cover.png.

steam_appid.description: fetch-art.sh downloads this Steam app's 600x900 library capsule as cover.jpg.

exec.description: argv. mygo and native: exec[0] is relative to the directory. command: exec[0] is looked up on PATH.

env.description: Extra environment. GAME_DIR is always set to the directory.

core.description: retroarch: the libretro core's name (snes9x, mgba, gambatte, ...).

rom.description: retroarch: the ROM, relative to the directory.

order.description: Cards sort by order, then title.

hidden.description: Keeps the directory off the games screen.
